confidence_notes: Food/drink anchors come from web-search summaries of aggregated indexes: Numbeo Orlando (Jul and Nov 2026 snapshots: inexpensive meal ~$21-22, mid-range meal for two ~$80-85, draft beer ~$5.50-6.00, cappuccino ~$5.2), Expatistan (thin samples: pub beer ~$7, club cocktail ~$15) and a national Toast median beer (~$6.61, Jul 2026). Data are crowd-sourced and snapshot dates are not fully clear. No direct Orlando glass-of-wine price was found, so wine (~1.8x beer) and cocktail (~2.1x beer, cross-checked against ~$12-15 at non-resort bars) rely on beer relationships; resort and tourist venues cost more. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates of pre-tax mid-summer nightly rates. No accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. Orlando has few hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Orlando-specific crowd-sourced indexes were used for food and drink where available, with US national restaurant medians as a beer cross-check. Accommodation is benchmarked from general knowledge against large US family-leisure destinations in peak summer.
